description: This file implements the procedures for stopping a DU cell, including handling UEs, stopping the cell, and ensuring UEs are released, with asynchronous operations and timers.

classes.name: du_cell_stop_procedure
classes.description: Class managing the procedure to stop a DU cell, including UEs release and cleanup.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine to stop the cell, release UEs, and ensure proper shutdown.

methods.name: force_ue_removal
methods.description: Forces removal of UEs associated with the cell, optionally triggering F1 reset.

methods.name: rem_ues_with_matching_pcell
methods.description: Handles UEs release process, either via CU request or direct reset.

methods.name: await_cu_to_release_ues
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for UEs to be released by CU, with timeout and fallback to force removal.
